title: Bluechip Invest
tagline: NFT Liquidity Provider, NFT Flip Tool, Collective Investment
description: The tool allows everyone to invest togheter into a NFT from OpenSea. The user that want to buy a Bluechip NFT can put part of the money combined with the money from other people with the objetive to buy the nft. Then they can do a Flip on Open Sea, selling the NFT for a Highest price, or sell part of the NFT into a market like Uniswap.
how_its_made: The project use: Wallet Connect to connect with Dapp, Reservoir to get the prices from Oracle like floor price, Seaport to validate de entrance on Open Sea Smart Contract with the Objective to Buy the NFT, all operations with contracts are using Tatum API to invoke the contracts, The Graph to Sync the investments data from Blockchain, and we use actively Tenderly to debug all operations and develop the Dapp.
